remarks: Beautifully updated four-bedroom home in the heart of Glenville. Step into the extra-height entryway, leading to an open floor plan with hardwood floors. The spacious, sunlit living room flows seamlessly into the dining area, creating the perfect space for gatherings. The eat-in kitchen offers ample storage and stainless steel appliances. Step outside to enjoy your morning coffee on the rear deck, overlooking the tranquil backyard. The main level features a primary bedroom, two additional bedrooms, and a hall bath. The lower level boasts a spacious family room and powder room, while a fourth bedroom provides flexibility for guests, a home office, or a gym. This low-maintenance home has been thoughtfully upgraded over time. Move right in and make this home yours.
